baseline.note: Expected behavior comes from the verified static baseline/parity contract; this matrix records only current V2 source coverage and never converts source presence into runtime acceptance.

acceptanceRule: No row is PASS/ACCEPTED from source evidence alone. Hardware/media/runtime gates remain separate.

features.expected: UltraCar cockpit/home illustrated dashboard with V1 proportions/background/sidebar/shortcuts in DeX
features.gap: Home shell exists, but original six governed media are not legally staged and screenshot parity is not accepted.
features.actual: HomeActivity renders the V2 cockpit shell with governed background/logo/vehicle resource references, clock, settings and shortcut grid.

features.expected: Vehicle card/model/color selection, parked/moving images and license plate
features.gap: Two vehicle image choices exist; full vehicle card, moving states and license plate parity are absent.
features.actual: HomeActivity switches between two parked vehicle resource IDs; full card/moving/license-plate state is absent.

features.expected: Real USB Host UVC streaming, image controls and USB permission lifecycle
features.gap: USB-host UVC source lifecycle exists; real USB camera preview/control QA is not accepted.
features.actual: UsbUvcController discovers USB video-class devices, requests device selection/open, starts preview and handles detach/cancel/error cleanup.

features.expected: Separate camera window with manual open/close while preserving real camera video
features.gap: Separate window and toggle path exist; real video/device behavior remains unaccepted.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity is a separate resizeable window with open/close controls and the same UVC controller used by the floating shortcut.

features.expected: Reverse signal plus 0.5m/1.0m/1.5m parking guide activation and calibration
features.gap: Intent-fed reverse/steering guide exists, but no verified vehicle reverse-signal source or calibrated distance acceptance exists.
features.actual: UsbCameraActivity accepts explicit reverse/steering intent values and DynamicGuideView draws curved guides only while camera frames and reverse state are active.

features.expected: Exactly one draggable transparent DeX Camera shortcut with the same action as in-app Camera
features.gap: Single transparent draggable shortcut source exists; DeX display behavior requires real-device QA.
features.actual: OverlayService creates one transparent draggable camera ImageButton on the resolved external display and taps into UsbCameraActivity.toggleFromShortcut.

features.expected: DeX auto-launch, multiple displays, freeform windows, zone overlays and layout persistence
features.gap: Per-display position persistence and geometry-change recovery are implemented in source; full DeX zone/freeform orchestration and real-device acceptance remain open.
features.actual: DexUtils detects desktop/external displays; OverlayService follows display add/change/remove, persists the draggable camera shortcut per display, migrates legacy x/y, clamps to active bounds, and forces re-attach when the current display geometry changes.

features.expected: Multi-zone/slot dashboard management with saved/default layouts and relaunch
features.gap: Local saved/default Home state is versioned and recovered safely; full V1 multi-zone orchestration remains absent.
features.actual: HomeActivity saves/applies/removes versioned local Home configurations containing theme, vehicle, driver and nine quick slots; a saved configuration can be the default restored on app creation, with legacy migration and corrupt-state cleanup.

features.expected: Road/city/theme/day/night/video/custom image Home backgrounds
features.gap: Day/night governed backgrounds are referenced; custom image/video background parity is absent and original media are not staged.
features.actual: HomeActivity supports day/night governed background resource references; no custom image/video background selector exists.

features.expected: Shortcut bar/map applications and bottom actions/image/music
features.gap: Nine assignable/launchable slots exist; complete V1 bottom-zone behavior and parity are not accepted.
features.actual: QuickBarGrid renders exactly nine slots in three rows; long press assigns/removes supported presets or package targets and click launches package/camera targets.

features.expected: GPS, battery/weather/telemetry and diagnostics zone
features.gap: No corresponding V2 source implementation found in the current scoped app.
features.actual: No scoped V2 GPS/weather/battery/telemetry zone implementation is present.

features.expected: OBD/Bluetooth pairing, speed/rpm/battery and diagnostics
features.gap: No corresponding V2 source implementation found in the current scoped app.
features.actual: No scoped V2 OBD/Bluetooth pairing or vehicle telemetry implementation is present.

features.expected: Taxi meter, trip distance/time/rates/history/revenue
features.gap: No corresponding V2 source implementation found in the current scoped app.
features.actual: No scoped V2 taxi meter/trip/rate/history/revenue implementation is present.

features.expected: Profile, identity/license, greeting and registration/extension
features.gap: No corresponding V2 profile/auth implementation found; Home driver display name is not feature parity.
features.actual: No scoped V2 profile/identity/license/registration implementation is present; driver display name alone is not parity.

features.expected: User/notification tabs and independent update checking
features.gap: No corresponding V2 source implementation found in the current scoped app.
features.actual: No scoped V2 notification tab or independent update-check implementation is present.

features.expected: Backup/export/import/restore all user settings/images/layout/shortcuts/sound/vehicle with security-bound exclusions
features.gap: Device-local SharedPreferences are not a backup/export/import/restore implementation.
features.actual: No export/import/restore backup implementation is present; private SharedPreferences persistence alone is not backup parity.

features.expected: Language/theme/appearance/color palettes
features.gap: Day/night Home toggle exists; language and full appearance/palette parity are absent.
features.actual: HomeActivity has a day/night toggle only; language and full appearance/palette surfaces are absent.

features.expected: Administrative/licensing/customer activation/device registration where legitimately available
features.gap: No corresponding V2 administrative/licensing implementation found.
features.actual: No scoped V2 administrative/licensing/customer activation/device-registration implementation is present.

features.expected: Data export/reporting sheets where supported by V1
features.gap: No corresponding V2 export/reporting implementation found.
features.actual: No scoped V2 report/sheet export implementation is present.

features.expected: Permissions for camera/USB/geolocation/overlay/update package/privacy/error recovery
features.gap: Camera/USB-host/overlay lifecycle is partially covered; geolocation/update/privacy/recovery parity is incomplete.
features.actual: Manifest and runtime source cover camera, USB-host feature declaration and overlay permission checks; geolocation/update/privacy/recovery parity remains incomplete.

features.expected: Responsive portrait/phone/landscape/DeX two/three-column profile cards without clipping
features.gap: Home uses proportional placement and handles configuration changes; required profile-card layouts and device-size acceptance are absent.
features.actual: HomeActivity uses proportional placement and re-renders on configuration changes; required phone/landscape/DeX profile-card layouts have not been device-accepted.

features.expected: Crash/restart, offline/backups, migration, coexistence, signing and rollback
features.gap: Local state migration/recovery is implemented in source, but full backup/restore, release signing and real rollback acceptance are still absent.
features.actual: V2 has an independent package, lifecycle/UVC cleanup, versioned local Home-state migration, bounded preset recovery and fail-closed handling for corrupt/future configuration schemas; signing/release/rollback acceptance remains open.
